target_title: Grain and cardinality contracts for engineering SQL
new_practice_contract: Keep core fixture; rebuild as follow -> reproduce -> changed fan-out debug -> validate -> explain. Must aggregate item grain before returning order grain and expose promotion/history fan-out.
critical_failure_coverage: Naive one-to-many/many-to-many join changes totals; DISTINCT hides fan-out

target_title: Staged transformations with CTEs and subqueries
new_practice_contract: Merge into one staged-transformation lab: derive order totals, average benchmark, then regional completed summary using named CTE stages; validate each stage separately.
critical_failure_coverage: Stage cannot be inspected; same query reused as its own validation

target_title: Window patterns for ranking, latest-row and sequence logic
new_practice_contract: One integrated window lab with row-preserving regional average, deterministic ranking/ties, explicit ROWS running frame, and monthly LAG with missing-period statement.
critical_failure_coverage: Tie/order/frame unspecified; missing period interpreted as zero without rule

target_title: Conditional and date transformations with explicit business rules
new_practice_contract: Merge KPI conditional aggregation and half-open timestamp/month transformation. Learner writes business rule/denominator/boundary before SQL.
critical_failure_coverage: Wrong denominator; inclusive upper timestamp boundary; date treated as text

new_practice_contract: Keep four diagnostic families but make severity/owner/action explicit: duplicate business events, orphans, numeric validity, temporal/history multiplicity.
critical_failure_coverage: Defect hidden/deleted without evidence; BLOCK/WARN unsupported

baseline_practice: old P-L10 plus validation parts across old tasks

critical_failure_coverage: Validation repeats same flawed logic; no source-to-output control
